namespace PubDC11

theorem partition_count_sum (p : Nat → Bool) (xs : List Nat) :
    (xs.filter p).length + (xs.filter (fun x => !p x)).length = xs.length := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x rest ih =>
    cases hp : p x <;> simp [List.filter, hp] <;> omega

end PubDC11
